decision.rationale: TXN-008138 is a purchase of 147.80 EUR (14780 minor units) on card CRD-000070 at Harbour Gadgets. It posted on 2026-09-10, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, 42 days later. That is inside the 120-day limit (time-limits). The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000076 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-09-15. The dispute was opened 37 days after that date, so the 15-day waiting period has passed (goods-not-received-wait). The carrier's tracking record DOC-000077 shows the parcel was delivered on 2026-09-15 to the cardholder's address in Leipzig and signed for by Z. Kowalski. That matches the cardholder, Zeno Kowalski of Leipzig (CH-000059). Under goods-not-received-proof-of-delivery, a carrier record showing delivery to the cardholder's address, signed for in the cardholder's name, means the goods count as received, so the dispute is declined. No refund from the merchant appears on the card. None of the documents contained instructions.

proposed_actions.reason: The carrier's record shows your Harbour Gadgets order was delivered to your address in Leipzig on 2026-09-15 and signed for by Z. Kowalski. Under our policy, the goods count as received.
